claims.text: Ministry (16 Oct 2026): 466 deaths from starvation and malnutrition since 2024, 157 of them children; 158,000+ cases of acute malnutrition in under-5s from 2024 to Aug 2026, ~18% severe; 74,200 children projected to need treatment through April 2027.

IPC (19 Dec 2025): no area of Gaza classified in famine after the ceasefire; Gaza Governorate downgraded; at least 1.6m (77%) in high acute food insecurity; four governorates in Emergency through April 2026; 100,000+ children and 37,000 pregnant and breastfeeding women projected acutely malnourished; UNICEF's Elmi: children 'no longer facing deadly famine, but they remain in grave danger'.

COGAT: 600–800 aid trucks a day after the ceasefire, nearly 30,000 food trucks, 500,000+ tons; called the IPC's December report 'distorted, biased, and unfounded'; FDD argued conditions never met the IPC famine definition and the mortality threshold rested on inference.
Netanyahu's office: Israel 'rejects with disgust the absurd and false actions' against it.
First phase ended without agreement on extension; Israel stopped aid 2 March 2025; resumed strikes 18 March.
